data.name: Hassun
data.gender_notes: Hassun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hasanah' which means 'good deed' or 'gift'. In Islamic context, Hassun can also mean 'the one who gives good news'. The name Hassun carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hassun usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the giving and receiving of blessings and good deeds.
data.etymology: Hassun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hassun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حسن
in_arabic.meaning: حسن کا مطلب خوبصورت، اچھا، محبوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسن ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، اچھا، یا محبوب۔ یہ نام حسن بن علی کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو پیغمبر اسلام کے داماد ہیں۔ حسن کا نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر نہیں ہے، لیکن یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ حسن بن علی کو ان کی خوبصورتی، اچھائی، اور نرم خوئی کے لیے جانا جاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: حسن
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسن ایک عربی نام ہے جو حسن بن علی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو پیغمبر اسلام کے داماد ہیں۔ یہ نام خوبصورتی، اچھائی، اور نرم خوئی کی علامت ہے۔ حسن کا نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جہاں یہ نام اچھائی اور خوبی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हसन
in_hindi.long_meaning: हसन एक अरबी नाम है जो हसन बिन अली के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो पैगंबर इस्लाम के दामाद हैं। यह नाम खूबसूरती, अच्छाई, और सौम्यता का प्रतीक है। हसन का नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, जहां यह नाम अच्छाई और खूबसूरती का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

in_pashto.name: حسن
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسن د عربي نوم دی چې د حسن بن علي لپاره کارول کيږي، چا چې د پيغمبر اسلام د داماد دی. دا نوم د ښه والي، نيکۍ، او نرم خویی نښه ده. حسن نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې ډیر اهمیت لري، چیرته چې دا نوم د نيکۍ او ښه والي استازیتوب کوي.

in_english.name: Hassun
in_english.long_meaning: Hassun is an Arabic name derived from the root 'h-s-n' which means beauty, goodness, or charm. It is commonly associated with Hasan bin Ali, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad. The name signifies virtues like kindness, compassion, and physical beauty. In Islamic tradition, Hassun or Hasan is considered a name that embodies positive attributes and moral excellence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hassun carries a profound cultural significance within the Islamic community, particularly due to its association with the concept of good deeds and giving. In various parts of the Middle East, especially countries with a predominantly Muslim population, the name Hassun is often given to newborn babies as an expression of hope and aspiration that the child will grow up to be a source of goodness, kindness, and charity to those around them. The name represents the values of generosity, kindness, and do-gooding, which are highly prized within Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hassun holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims as it is derived from the Arabic word 'hasanah', which means 'good deed'. The name is a constant reminder of the importance of performing good deeds and striving for spiritual growth. Muslims believe that the accumulation of good deeds leads to salvation and a higher rank in paradise. By giving the name Hassun to a child, parents are encouraging them to follow the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad, who emphasized the importance of doing good, giving to those in need, and spreading kindness and compassion. The name also holds a spiritual significance as it directly translates to 'the giver of good news'. Muslims believe that the best form of good news is the news of Allah's mercy and forgiveness, and the name Hassun is a reminder to always strive to be a source of good news and positivity in the world.
